subject: history_social
passage: Stepwells are deep, stone-lined wells that were built across western India over many centuries. Long flights of steps lead down to the ______ could reach it even when the water level dropped during the dry season. Some stepwells also have carved pillars and shaded galleries.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "Long flights of steps lead down to the water" and "people could reach it even when the water level dropped" are both independent clauses. A comma followed by the coordinating conjunction "so" correctly joins them and shows the cause-and-effect link.
explanation.A: Correct. A comma plus "so" correctly joins the two independent clauses.
explanation.B: Incorrect. When "so" joins two independent clauses, a comma is needed before it.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A comma alone can't join two independent clauses; this creates a comma splice.
explanation.D: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the two independent clauses run together (a run-on sentence).
